weapons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent UI weapon icon atlas for a humorous chibi Three Kingdoms survival game.
Input images: image 1 is a style reference for existing detailed weapon art, not an edit target. Image 2 is the game's chibi character style reference. Match warm dark-brown thick ink outlines, clean rounded cartoon forms, warm cream highlights, restrained painterly cel shading. Clear immediately recognizable silhouettes at only 48 px. Avoid tiny engravings.
Primary request: ONE exact 4 columns × 3 rows sprite atlas on genuine transparent background, square equal cells, no gutters drawn, no labels, no frame or background plate. Each separate weapon floats centered inside its cell with at least 10% transparent margin, occupies about 78% of cell, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Horizontal sheet aspect ratio 4:3.
Strict row-major order:
row 1: 1 golden woven straw sandal (single shoe, obvious woven sole and Y strap, tilted diagonally); 2 open tan cloth sack full of bright green mung beans, three beans visible spilling at lip; 3 a sturdy forked brown peach twig with three big pink peach blossoms and two green leaves, clearly a branch; 4 large rectangular silver butcher cleaver with obvious steel blade, small hole near corner, short red-brown wooden handle.
row 2: 5 wooden rolling pin with thick barrel and two narrow handles, diagonal; 6 tied bundle of three red cylindrical Chinese firecrackers with gold end caps and curved lit fuse, tiny spark only; 7 short toy-like wooden-and-brass submachine gun with obvious magazine/grip and short perforated barrel, red cloth knot; 8 clearly distinct long double-barrel shotgun with wood stock, two side-by-side dark metal barrels, red tassel.
row 3: 9 bulky olive-green rocket launcher tube with red pointed rocket visibly loaded at mouth and two grips, brass bands; 10 group of three rigid jade flying swords with golden guards, cyan blades, small teal tassels; 11 two yellow folded Taoist lightning talismans with a large simple red lightning zigzag (not text) and tiny purple bolt; 12 purple double-lobed magical gourd with golden cork and red cord tied at waist, tiny curl of purple mist.
All weapons iconic oversized shapes, consistent illustrated quality. Distinguish gun types by outline not color. Flat 2D game illustration, not realistic rendering. Keep weapon edges crisply inked, no large glows, no drop shadows, no text, no watermark, no hands, no characters, no grids. Truly transparent alpha between all objects.

heroes.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: transparent modular 2D character animation sprite atlas, ONE sheet, exact 3 columns × 3 rows, square equal cells.
Input images 1,2,3 are identity references for Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei respectively. Preserve their exact round chibi head proportions, original simple bean body robes, facial hair, hairstyle, ribbons, palette, thick dark brown ink outline and soft cel shading. The atlas is NOT full body portraits: heads and headless torsos are separate parts to animate in code.
Transparent empty background with real alpha, no text/grid/guides/shadow. Each item centered in its own cell, transparent gutter at least 8%, never cross cell boundaries.
Columns from left to right: Liu Bei / Guan Yu / Zhang Fei.
ROW 1: HEAD ONLY for each hero, no neck, no body, no hands, no weapons. Include entire hair/hat, ears, beard and ribbons. Liu Bei green ribbon/topknot, peach skin, heavy eyebrows, mischievous half-lidded eyes OPEN with visible dark pupils and whites, cheerful small smile and small chin beard. Guan Yu green hat, red face, long black beard, stern funny eyes OPEN. Zhang Fei black hair/red ribbon, peach face/huge shaggy beard, grinning mouth, expressive thick eyebrows, slightly OPEN tiny crescent-shaped laughing eyes with visible pupils (not fully shut). All heads front-facing. Fit entire head INCLUDING beard in centered 84% region.
ROW 2: EXACT SAME HEADS as row 1 in same center, scale, silhouette, outline, hair, ears, beard, mouth position and expression, change ONLY eyes to fully CLOSED eyelids in a natural brief blink. No white eyeballs or pupils. Must be perfectly registrable as animation alternate frames. Do not tilt or resize these heads. Guan eyes relax closed, Zhang eyelids squeezed shut, Liu relaxed horizontal closed lids.
ROW 3: HEADLESS / ARMLESS / FOOTLESS short BEAN TORSO ROBE for each hero, no head/hair/ears/beard, no hands, no feet, no weapons. Liu green robe cream crossed collar red waist belt, Guan green robe cream collar/gold belt details, Zhang purple robe red waist knot. Each torso compact round shape, centered in its square cell, occupies about 70% of cell WIDTH and 70% height. Standalone cutout with a simple rounded upper collar edge that can sit BEHIND a separately rendered head. All three shirt parts consistent scale.
Strict preserve character identities, no redesigned armor, no tall bodies, no necks or realistic limbs. Clean strong silhouettes readable at game size. All first-row and second-row heads must share the SAME pixel bounding box and alignment per column, only eyelids change. Crisp reusable animation parts, avoid decorative sparkles, avoid emotional tears or injury.
heroes.runtimeExport: Original generated RGBA image, unchanged; explicit measured source rectangles rather than assumed equal grid.
